items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice Thursday for the second straight day after exiting Week 4 early; considered week-to-week.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs post-Week 4 hamstring; Rapoport week-to-week context.
items.implication: Likely miss or GTD vs JAX in London; backfield opens.
items.opportunity: Lead carries/routes to remaining RBs; red-zone/goal-line vacuum.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) DNP Thursday after missing Wednesday; trending toward miss vs JAX.
items.implication: Targets shift to other WRs/TE if out; Hurts downgrade.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) DNP Thursday; Friday practice key for SNF availability vs ATL.
items.why: Ankle injury; consecutive DNPs; Huntley next up.
items.implication: If out, downgrade Flowers/Andrews/Likely; Huntley streaming option.

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore did not practice Thursday due to shoulder injury.
items.implication: Monitor Friday; potential miss impacts Bills pass game.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (foot) no practice again Thursday (second straight DNP).
items.implication: Targets to Johnston/others if out vs DEN.
items.opportunity: Route/target share increase for remaining WRs.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. aggravated foot (plantar fasciitis); coach says miss multiple weeks.
items.opportunity: Increased WR share for DK Metcalf etc.

items.text: ETR/Levitan: With Barkley and Bigsby out/IR, expect the Will Shipley show as lead back vs Jacksonville.
items.why: Barkley/Bigsby injuries open full role; volume-based flex despite tough matchup/OL issues.
items.implication: Shipley RB2/flex volume play; reverse if Barkley unexpectedly active.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) DNP consecutive days, week-to-week; Allen heavy snaps if out.
items.implication: Berry: Allen top-20 RB if Hall out.

items.text: Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams performing well above expected fantasy points on opportunities; Ashton Jeanty and Chase Brown underperforming.
items.why: xFP data sortable for subscribers; opportunity over recent points.
items.implication: Sustain or regression watch; Jeanty/Brown buy-low potential if role holds.
items.opportunity: High efficiency on carries/targets for Bijan/Kyren.
items.conflict: Berry loves Chase Brown RB5 despite underperformance.

items.text: Titans WR Carnell Tate limited Thursday with back injury.
items.implication: Monitor; Berry has as WR19 love vote.

items.text: Berry loves Nico Collins vs Titans as WR8; volume including red-zone vs soft defense.
Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload + Bengals injury context + soft run D.
Berry loves Isaiah Likely TE5 @ WSH and Christian Watson WR15 vs CHI on coverage/positional weaknesses.
Berry hates Jordan Addison WR41 @ NO (injury wrinkle + role) and Mark Andrews TE17 @ ATL.
items.why: Tough matchups, thin roles, usage data.
